templates.name: Battle Area Clearance Daily Log
templates.description: End-of-day BAC operational log — area cleared, items found, detonations, and team status.

steps.title: Establish Cordon
steps.description: Set minimum safety cordon. Post sentries. Clear non-essential personnel.

steps.title: Approach Route Assessment
steps.description: Identify safe lane. Check for secondary devices, tripwires, pressure plates.

steps.title: Item Identification
steps.description: Record type, condition, fuze status from safe distance. Do not touch.

steps.title: Select Render Safe Procedure
steps.description: Choose RSP based on item type, condition, and available equipment.

steps.title: Disruptor / Hook and Line
steps.description: Apply hook and line or disruptor shot if IED. Stand by for 30 min after misfire.

steps.title: Execute RSP
steps.description: Carry out selected RSP. All non-essential personnel behind cover.

steps.title: Misfire Wait
steps.description: Wait minimum 30 min electric / 1 hr non-electric before approaching.

steps.title: Post-Blast Inspection
steps.description: Inspect detonation site. Confirm complete detonation. Collect fragments for ID.

steps.title: Area Clearance
steps.description: Search immediate area for secondary items and residue.

steps.title: Documentation
steps.description: Complete task report. Record GPS, item details, method, result, personnel.

steps.title: Site Handover
steps.description: Brief responsible authority. Remove cordon. Confirm area all-clear.

templates.name: CBRN Decontamination Procedure
templates.description: Step-by-step decontamination checklist for personnel and equipment following CBRN exposure.

steps.title: Detection & Alarm
steps.description: Confirm CBRN alarm. Note agent type, wind direction, time of detection.

steps.title: Immediate Actions (AVOID-MASK-WARN)
steps.description: Stop breathing. Don mask and hood. Warn others – shout CBRN ALERT.

steps.title: Full PPE / MOPP
steps.description: Don full protective ensemble. Check buddy seal. Log time on.

steps.title: Establish Hazard Zones
steps.description: Set Hot / Warm / Cold zones. Evacuate non-essential personnel upwind.

steps.title: Agent Identification
steps.description: Deploy detection equipment. Record readings. Report to HQ.

steps.title: Casualty Management
steps.description: Triage casualties. Administer immediate antidote (atropine if nerve agent). Move to decon.

steps.title: Decontamination
steps.description: Execute ladder / thorough decon. Undress, shower, redress. Discard contaminated items.

steps.title: Sampling
steps.description: Collect liquid, vapour, or swab samples. Label and package for lab.

steps.title: Medical Evacuation
steps.description: Evacuate casualties through decon lane to medical point.

steps.title: CBRN Report (MEDINTEL)
steps.description: Submit CBRN 1 report. Include agent, location, wind, casualties, PPE worn.

steps.title: Area Clearance Monitoring
steps.description: Monitor continuously until readings below clearance threshold. Confirm all-clear.

templates.name: Daily Safety Briefing
templates.description: Pre-operation safety briefing checklist for field teams — hazards, emergency plans, comms, and go/no-go decision.

steps.title: Safety Briefing
steps.description: Conduct toolbox talk. Confirm all personnel understand hazards, PPE requirements, and emergency procedures.

steps.title: PPE Inspection
steps.description: Verify correct PPE is worn and serviceable. No exceptions.

steps.title: Site Walk-Around
steps.description: Inspect all work areas for slip/trip hazards, unsecured loads, open excavations.

steps.title: Equipment / Tools Check
steps.description: Confirm all equipment has current inspection tag. Check guards, cables, grounding.

steps.title: Emergency Procedures Confirmed
steps.description: Identify muster point, first aider, nearest hospital. Confirm radio / comms working.

steps.title: Fire Prevention Check
steps.description: No smoking in restricted areas. Extinguishers accessible. Hot work permit in place if needed.

steps.title: Hazardous Materials Check
steps.description: SDS sheets present. Storage compliant. Spill kits available.

steps.label: Safety Signage
steps.title: Safety Signage Confirmed
steps.description: All warning signs, barriers, and exclusion zone markers in place.

steps.title: Record & Close
steps.description: Sign inspection sheet. Report deficiencies to supervisor. Confirm work can proceed.

steps.title: Confirm briefing record
steps.description: Confirm the date, team and attendance are recorded in the briefing log.

steps.title: Assign outstanding actions
steps.description: Confirm each unresolved briefing item has a responsible person and follow-up reference in the team log.

templates.name: Trail Condition Assessment
templates.description: A practical field form for trail condition, maintenance and follow-up. Use the same fields for point, line and area observations. Start with location and condition, choose the maintenance priority, then record follow-up and photos. Optional measurements and notes add detail when needed. Priorities are planning prompts; teams set response dates under their own procedures.

fields.label: Inspector / Team
fields.placeholder: Name or team identifier

fields.label: Trail Section
fields.placeholder: Trail name, section number and nearest access point

fields.label: Direction / Chainage or Location Reference
fields.placeholder: e.g. northbound, km 12.4 from south trailhead; record datum/start point

fields.label: Condition Rating
options: 2 - Fair: minor defect; use largely unaffected
4 - Critical: severe damage or hazard; urgent assessment

fields.label: Affected Length (m)
fields.placeholder: Optional for line observations; leave blank if not measured

fields.label: Affected Area (m²)
fields.placeholder: Optional for area observations; leave blank if not measured

fields.label: Notes
fields.placeholder: Describe the defect, extent and evidence. For Other, specify the issue. For accessibility, describe the barrier; for water points, record availability, not assumed potability.

fields.label: Priority
options: P1 - Urgent: notify responsible team now
P2 - High: schedule at earliest opportunity
P3 - Routine: include in planned maintenance
P4 - Monitor: no immediate work proposed

fields.label: Work Required / Recommended Action
fields.placeholder: Describe proposed work, materials, access and any specialist input; explain Other here.

fields.label: Assigned Team / Responsible Party
fields.placeholder: Optional; leave blank until responsibility is agreed

fields.label: Follow-up / Completion Notes
fields.placeholder: If follow-up is needed, agree a date or explain why pending. Record completion evidence and verifier before closing.

templates.name: Vehicle Pre-Op Inspection
templates.description: Pre-operation vehicle safety checklist — lights, tyres, fluids, comms, first aid, and driver readiness.

steps.title: Safety Briefing
steps.description: Conduct toolbox talk. Confirm all personnel understand hazards, PPE requirements, and emergency procedures.

steps.title: PPE Inspection
steps.description: Verify correct PPE is worn and serviceable. No exceptions.

steps.title: Site Walk-Around
steps.description: Inspect all work areas for slip/trip hazards, unsecured loads, open excavations.

steps.title: Equipment / Tools Check
steps.description: Confirm all equipment has current inspection tag. Check guards, cables, grounding.

steps.title: Emergency Procedures Confirmed
steps.description: Identify muster point, first aider, nearest hospital. Confirm radio / comms working.

steps.title: Fire Prevention Check
steps.description: No smoking in restricted areas. Extinguishers accessible. Hot work permit in place if needed.

steps.title: Hazardous Materials Check
steps.description: SDS sheets present. Storage compliant. Spill kits available.

steps.label: Safety Signage
steps.title: Safety Signage Confirmed
steps.description: All warning signs, barriers, and exclusion zone markers in place.

steps.title: Record & Close
steps.description: Sign inspection sheet. Report deficiencies to supervisor. Confirm work can proceed.

steps.title: Confirm vehicle inspection record
steps.description: Confirm the vehicle identifier and inspection date are recorded in the fleet log.

steps.title: Record vehicle-specific observations
steps.description: Record visible tyre, light, mirror and fluid-leak observations in the fleet inspection record; refer defects to the responsible maintainer.

steps.title: Confirm defect handover
steps.description: Confirm unresolved defects and the responsible person are recorded. Checklist completion is not roadworthiness certification.
